name: Library Overlay Cards
description: Squares off your library grid cards and overlays the title and owner directly on the cover art.

name: Folder Artwork
description: Gives playlist folders real artwork - the first playlist's cover, or a 2x2 mosaic when the folder holds four or more.

name: Volume Plus (updated)
description: Finer volume control with scroll and arrow-key support. Updated fork of Aspecky's volume-plus, fixed for current Spotify versions.
